title: Avatar
description: Fiori avatar (XS–XL, circle/square, initials/icon/image, accent colours, interactive) and AvatarGroup.

usage.summary: Represent people or business entities with recognizable images, initials or placeholders.
useWhen: Help users recognize a person, product or business entity consistently across the application.
Use shape="circle" for people, shape="square" for business entities, and initials for 1–3 Latin letters when no photo exists.
Show related people together with AvatarGroup, and provide meaningful alternative text for identity images.

avoidWhen.when: Browse a sequence of pictures rather than represent one identity.
Select image or video thumbnails to inspect the corresponding media.
